config.experiment: M1A.1 — long-horizon & resolution diagnostics (no model changes)
config.diagnostic_only: M1A feedback rule, stopping rule and throw distribution are unchanged; this experiment only observes them longer and at finer resolution.
config.throw_distribution: q_near(x) = 2(1-x); bin probabilities from exact CDF integration at every K (never copied across K)

metric.cross_resolution: U_density(t) = K * U(t)  (density-L2 discretization; raw U not compared across K)
metric.cross_resolution_2: D_max(t) = max_j [cumulative mass - j/K] (one-sided CDF discrepancy; directly comparable across K)

boundary_ambiguity.note: diagnostic thresholds only; they never alter the sweep policy

config.d_profiles_figure_rounds: auto: early, medium, late, plus before/after the largest boundary jump

headline.first_divergence_note: K=100 run reproduces the canonical M1A trajectory bit-for-bit for t=0..100
